messages:
alex (AE): Quick ask — Acme signed the PO, starting a 30d POC. Need billing org + project, dedicated pool reserved for POC, VPC peering enabled, and ephemeral API keys for their devs. They want a hard spend cap of $5,000 and per-project quotas. Also customer SOC2 requirement: audit logs exported to their S3. Who can help provision and confirm pricing/commit?

marta (SE): Congrats! Couple Qs: which model family + expected peak RPS? Dedicated pool size affects committed monthly cost.

alex (AE): They plan to run a 2-worker perf test (redwood/gpt-large-ish) with 8k seq, est ~50 rps bursts, avg 5 rps. Can you suggest pool size and whether we can do a temporary 2-week extra capacity?

sam (Platform Eng): For ~50 rps bursts we recommend a 4-GPU dedicated pool (A100/80GB equivalents) with burst policy. We can allocate ephemeral capacity for 2 weeks as a temporary burst; need the project id and start/end dates. Also for ephemeral API keys we use the ephemeral-keys flow (short-lived tokens provisioned via service account). Example policy snippet below to set spend guard + quotas on the billing project: 

```yaml
billing_project: "acme-poc-1998"
spend_guard:
  hard_cap_usd: 5000
  notify_thresholds: [0.5, 0.8, 0.95]
quotas:
  requests_per_minute: 500
  tokens_per_day: 2000000
key_policy:
  ephemeral_ttl_minutes: 120
  allowed_scopes: ["inference:generate", "embeddings:create"]
```

sam (Platform Eng): For VPC peering we need Acme's CIDR + contact for config. For audit logs to S3: we'll create a log-export role; security will need to approve cross-account access.

jess (Customer Success): I'll coordinate with Acme's infra lead (cc'ed via email). We promised 10k in free credits for the POC; can finance confirm allocation? Also they asked about pricing if they go beyond $5k during test — we should state overage policy up front.

oliver (Finance): Can confirm: we can seed the billing project with $10,000 trial credits applied to charges first. The hard spend cap (hard_cap_usd) will block further usage once hit — platform-enforced. For overage, if they request a temporary lift we require PO amendment. We'll note that reserved dedicated pool has a minimum monthly commit — for a 4-GPU pool that's $X/month (I'll DM the exact $).

marta (SE): Two follow-ups: 1) For SOC2 logs -> do we need to provide signed SLA for log retention? 2) Does Acme require customer-managed KMS for key encryption?

alex (AE): They require 1yr retention and want keys in their KMS (AWS). They also want the ability to rotate ephemeral keys on their schedule.

sam (Platform Eng): We support exporting logs to a customer S3 and using customer-managed KMS for log encryption. For ephemeral key rotation we can accept a webhook to trigger re-issuance, or they can use our OAuth flow. I'll open an infra ticket.

devops-bot: Created internal ticket: INFRA-4521 — "acme poc: billing project + dedicated pool + vpc peering + s3 log export" assigned to @sam. Link: https://redwood.internal/INFRA-4521

sam (Platform Eng): Action items I need: (1) confirmed project id to create, (2) Acme CIDR + contact for peering, (3) start/end for burst capacity. I'll provision ephemeral key template and the policy above.

jess (Customer Success): I'll get the CIDR + contact today and share here. Also sending the SOC2 checklist items to Acme and will escalate any blockers.

oliver (Finance): I've reserved $10k trial credits to billing project placeholder; please provide final project id so I can attach. Hard cap will be set to $5k per request from Sales.

marta (SE): Perfect. Once INFRA-4521 has a PR for IAM roles/log-export and pool sizing I'll review and sign off.

alex (AE): Thanks all. Plan: jess to collect networking + SOC answers, sam provisions infra + ephemeral keys, oliver ties credits to project, marta validates pool config. Target: POC live in 5 business days. :rocket:

sam (Platform Eng): Noted. I'll start on infra tomorrow morning.

jess (Customer Success): On it.
